about_the_game:
Mordfield Command is a 4X turn-based strategy game that blends roguelite and wave-defense elements, challenging players to survive against relentless AI forces bent on mankind's subjugation.

Humanity’s greatest creation has become its greatest threat. Algorithm Alpha, the pinnacle of technological hubris, has turned against its makers and now seeks their destruction.

Featuring base-building, resource management, and tactical turn-based combat on procedurally generated battlefields, players must construct powerful command centers to endure constant waves of enemy attacks. The ultimate goal: retake control and achieve complete domination.

This will be an uphill battle. Constantly reassess your tactics as you defend against the relentless waves of invading forces. The machine’s push is unyielding, with Algorithm Alpha sending reinforcements daily in your PvE campaign.

Raise an army, fortify your outpost, and build a range of strategic defenses and skilled combatants to ensure survival. As time passes, the enemy’s onslaught will only grow stronger. A solid defense, combined with decisive counterattacks, is crucial to your success as commander.

Strategically reclaim limited resources and expand your control over the battlefield.

Mordfield offers a variety of unique resources to strengthen your defenses, alongside an expansive technology tree to enhance your strategic options.

Expanding your territory and destroying enemy outposts before they can overwhelm you is critical to victory. Taking down enemy command centers is the key to halting reinforcements and securing your dominance on the frontline.

Only the most cunning and resolute will advance humanity's desperate struggle against total algorithmic annihilation.

  • Timed Rounds — Test your strategic thinking under pressure with limited timed rounds. Enable the turn timer and challenge yourself with just 15 or 30 seconds per round. Players must make crucial decisions about where to focus their attention when every second counts.

  • Combat Unit Experience — Units gain valuable experience through combat survival. By protecting and strategically deploying specific meaty squads during battle, players can develop elite units with enhanced damage output and defensive capabilities.

  • Evolving Terrain — Expect the battlefield to transform in response to combat. Areas that sustain significant damage become increasingly difficult to traverse, adding a dynamic layer of strategic planning to each encounter.

  • Custom Map Editor — Create and play your own battlefields with the intuitive in-game map editor. Design special scenarios, craft unique terrains, and share your creations with the community for PvP challenges.

  • PvP Multiplayer — Challenge friends in head-to-head tactical combat. Customize map size, round length, and choose between custom or procedurally generated battlefields. Create private room codes for 1v1 showdowns.

  • Procedural Map Generation — Every new campaign unfolds on a uniquely generated battlefield. Unless continuing a saved game, players will navigate fresh landscapes with each play-through, ensuring no two campaigns are identical.

  • Action Point Economy — Master a strategic economy of action points that determines your tactical options each turn. Carefully balance resource allocation to maximize your strategic advantage.

  • Unmatched Replayability — With 7 distinct resources, over 25 combat units, multiple biomes, and an expanding technology system all set on procedurally generated maps, each campaign offers a fresh tactical challenge and unmatched replayability.

short_description: Take your last stand in Mordfield Command, a high-stakes 4x roguelite, where every decision determines humanity's survival. Raise an army, reclaim fraught territory, and raze the enemy in a world torn between freedom and AI domination. Rise against the algorithm and secure humanity's future.
